description: Central moss-rimmed cistern, supported timber pulley with chained bucket, perimeter maintenance ring.
differences: Clear cyan-glass safety lid at well rim prevents falls; water is two blocks deep and not a swimming objective.
Pulley and bucket are connected block sculpture; no mechanical lowering or water extraction claim.
Outer channels reduced to contained coral pools; dry maintenance ring and ports.
water_policy: DRY HABITABLE COMPARTMENT, contained wet aquarium planters and shallow pools; not a fully flooded ocean ruin. All route goals remain dry. Glass enclosure for deployment preparation, not certified deep-ocean pressure/oxygen safety.
